sn10.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn10.9:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Sukkā bhikkhunī mahatiyā parisāya parivutā dhammam deseti || || 3.
sn10.9:1.3: Atha kho Sukkāya bhikkhuniyā abhippasanno yakkho Rājagahe rathikāya rathikam siṅghāṭakena siṅghāṭakam upasaṅkamitvā tāyaṃ velāyam imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
